fieldValues.title: Master had no branch protection at all
fieldValues.summary: The srs repository's master branch carried no branch protection, while the process described Release Drift as a required context. A required context that is not configured as required is a description of intent, not a gate.
evidence: No protection rule existed on srs master before the rule added under srs#576 — strict, validate-all and check-release-drift required, 0 required reviews, admins exempt.

The gate was then proved in both directions rather than assumed: srs#577 was a deliberately red pull request with auto-merge armed that stayed BLOCKED and did not merge; srs#578 auto-merged with no human approval.
